import csv,hashlib,json,struct
from pathlib import Path
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1];b=(R/'prior/inputs/nite3w - 110.exe').read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()=='12fe5168783446275802e0e947898261b5eca6b88288f3a895fc1faa4c544481'
ne=struct.unpack_from('<I',b,0x3c)[0];st=ne+struct.unpack_from('<H',b,ne+0x22)[0];shift=struct.unpack_from('<H',b,ne+0x32)[0]
o,n,_,_=struct.unpack_from('<4H',b,st);c=b[o<<shift:(o<<shift)+n]
status=list(struct.unpack_from('<4H',c,0x1cd));buttons=list(struct.unpack_from('<14H',c,0x1d5));rows=list(c[0x537c:0x5381])
assert status==[0,0xe701,0xe702,0xe703]
assert rows==[6,15,15,15,6]
assert c[0x5382:0x538c]==b'.INI\0.HLP\0'
assert c[0x5b94:0x5bbe].hex()=='8a4ef4c45ef6ff46f6268a072ae4d3e0f7d08946fc88248a46fc8844018b46f203c003f04783ff057cd6'
# Two independently expressed bitmap-buffer constructions, before GDI interpretation.
def literal(w,h):
 w=min(w,32);h=min(h,32);stride=(w+15)>>4;shift=min((w-4)//2,12);mem=bytearray([255]*128)
 si=((h-6)>>1)*stride*2
 for row in rows:
  ax=(~((row<<(shift&31))&65535))&65535;mem[si]=ax>>8;mem[si+1]=ax&255;si+=stride*2
 return w,h,mem
def spec(w,h):
 w=min(w,32);h=min(h,32);stride=2*((w+15)//16);left=min((w-4)//2,12);mem=bytearray([255]*128)
 for i,bits in enumerate([0b0110,0b1111,0b1111,0b1111,0b0110]):
  offset=((h-6)//2+i)*stride
  value=65535^((bits<<left)&65535);mem[offset:offset+2]=value.to_bytes(2,'big')
 return w,h,mem
cases=0
for w in range(4,65):
 for h in range(6,65):assert literal(w,h)==spec(w,h);cases+=1
toolbar=[];image=0
for ident in buttons:
 toolbar.append(dict(id=ident,flags=1 if ident==0 else 0,value='this.word22+2' if ident==0 else image))
 if ident:image+=1
out=dict(exe_sha256=hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),status_ids=status,toolbar_ids=buttons,toolbar_records=toolbar,nonzero_button_count=image,menu_row_bytes=rows,bitmap_model_cases=cases,defined_bytes=51,strings={"1000:5382":'.INI',"1000:5387":'.HLP'},runtime_tests=0,limits=['Model covers positive width4..64,height6..64 with signed upper cap32','No GDI rendering or selector faults modeled','No lower-dimension clamp exists locally','ID-to-command names unassigned'])
o,n,_,_=struct.unpack_from('<4H',b,st+16);game=b[o<<shift:(o<<shift)+n]
maps=list(csv.DictReader((R/'pass5/message_entries.tsv').open(),delimiter='\t'));chain=[]
rel={(x['source_segment'],x['source']):x for x in json.loads((R/'pass2/relocation_chain_sites.json').read_text()) if x['type']==2 and x['flags']==0}
for ident in buttons:
 if not ident:chain.append(dict(id=0,role='separator'));continue
 matches=[r for r in maps if r['map']=='1048:0010' and int(r['selector0'])==0 and int(r['selector1'])==ident]
 assert len(matches)==1;r=matches[0];at=int(r['entry'].split(':')[1],16);words=struct.unpack_from('<5H',c,at)
 assert words[:3]==(0,ident,10)
 handler=int(r['handler'].split(':')[1],16);assert words[3]==handler
 assert rel[(1,at+8)]['target_segment']==3
 row=dict(id=ident,entry=r['entry'],handler=r['handler'],signature=10)
 if ident==0x8012:
  assert game[handler:handler+3]==bytes.fromhex('9aaa0d') and rel[(3,handler+3)]['target_segment']==3;row['callee']='1010:0daa'
 else:
  assert game[handler:handler+2]==bytes.fromhex('666a') and game[handler+3:handler+6]==bytes.fromhex('9ad28c')
  assert rel[(3,handler+6)]['target_segment']==3
  row['key_word']=game[handler+2];row['flags_word']=0;row['callee']='1010:8cd2'
 chain.append(row)
out['toolbar_dispatch_chain']=chain
(R/'pass10/ui_data_verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(out,indent=2))
